entries.name: Beef, Lamb, Goat, Bison, Venison, Elk
entries.details: Split hoof + chews cud [Lev 11:3]. All cuts approved if plain

entries.name: Chicken, Turkey, Duck, Quail, Pheasant, Goose
entries.details: Not on forbidden bird list [Lev 11:13-19]. Domestic poultry permitted

entries.name: Salmon, Tuna, Cod, Trout, Mackerel, Sardines, Herring, Bass, Snapper, Halibut, Tilapia
entries.details: Fins and scales present [Lev 11:9]. All permitted

entries.name: ALL PORK: ham, bacon, pork chops, lard, pepperoni, pork sausage, pork gelatin
entries.details: [Lev 11:7-8]. Removed from this diet in all forms

entries.name: Shrimp, Lobster, Crab, Oysters, Clams, Mussels, Scallops, Squid
entries.details: No fins and scales [Lev 11:10-12]. All shellfish forbidden

entries.name: Catfish, Shark, Eel, Swordfish, Sturgeon
entries.details: No true scales [Lev 11:10]. Forbidden regardless of local availability

entries.name: Beef (grass-fed)
entries.details: Ground beef, sirloin, ribeye, liver, stew beef [Lev 11:3]
entries.alt: Injected beef with soy solution; any listing 'soy protein' or 'soybean oil'

entries.name: Lamb / Goat
entries.details: All cuts [Lev 11:3]. High zinc and iron
entries.alt: Pre-marinated or pre-seasoned (check for soy and added sugar)

entries.name: Bison / Venison / Elk
entries.details: All plain cuts [Lev 11:3]. Lean, high iron
entries.alt: Pre-marinated or sauced versions

entries.name: Chicken
entries.details: Organic, air-chilled, plain [Lev 11:13-19]
entries.alt: Injected chicken labeled 'up to 15% solution' — soy in the brine

entries.name: Turkey
entries.details: Ground turkey plain, turkey breast [Lev 11:13-19]
entries.alt: Pre-seasoned roasts, flavored ground turkey with added seasonings

entries.name: Duck / Quail / Pheasant
entries.details: All plain, not on forbidden bird list [Lev 11:13-19]
entries.alt: Sweet-glazed or pre-marinated preparations

entries.name: Organ Meats
entries.details: Beef liver, chicken liver — highest iron and B12 of any food [Lev 11:3]
entries.alt: Organ meats from unclean animals

entries.name: ALL PORK
entries.details: NONE — completely removed from this diet
entries.alt: Ham, bacon, pork chops, lard, pepperoni, pork rinds, prosciutto [Lev 11:7-8]

entries.name: Kirkland Canned Chicken (Costco)
entries.details: Ingredients: chicken, water, salt. Clean, affordable, bulk. Best value canned chicken. Buy by the case.

entries.name: Member's Mark Canned Chicken (Sam's Club)
entries.details: Chicken breast, water, salt. Bulk multi-pack. Verify current label. Great pantry protein staple at Sam's.

entries.name: Member's Mark Grassfed Beef Snack Sticks (Sam's Club)
entries.details: 100% grass-fed beef, 0g sugar, no nitrates, no nitrites, no MSG, gluten-free. 9g protein per stick, 12-pack. Naturally seasoned with celery powder, sea salt, spices. Excellent clean grab-and-go protein. Sam's Club.

entries.name: Valley Fresh Canned Chicken
entries.details: Ingredients: chicken, water, salt. Widely available at Walmart, Target, Publix. No soy, no broth.

entries.name: Trader Joe's Canned Chicken
entries.details: Clean label. Affordable. Verify current label shows chicken, water, salt only.

entries.name: Wild Planet Tuna (in water)
entries.details: Wild-caught albacore or skipjack. No vegetable broth, no soy. Fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Whole Foods, Target, Amazon.

entries.name: Safe Catch Tuna
entries.details: Tests every fish for mercury. Clean label. No soy, no broth. Good for frequent consumption. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.name: Member's Mark Chunk Light / Albacore Tuna (Sam's Club)
entries.details: Tuna, water, salt in the plain water-packed version. Fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Bulk multi-pack. Check label for 'vegetable broth' and choose water-pack only. Sam's Club.

entries.name: Wild Planet Sardines (water or olive oil)
entries.details: Wild-caught, no soy, fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. High omega-3, iron, vitamin D. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.name: Crown Prince Sardines (water)
entries.details: BPA-free can, clean label, no soy. Budget-friendly option. Walmart, Publix, Amazon.

entries.name: Wild Planet Wild Salmon (canned)
entries.details: Pink salmon, wild-caught, no soy, no broth, fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Whole Foods, Costco.

entries.name: Applegate Naturals Turkey Deli
entries.details: No soy, no nitrates, no dyes, no HFCS. Turkey breast slices. Find at Whole Foods, Publix, Target.

entries.name: Applegate Naturals Beef Hot Dogs
entries.details: No pork, no soy, no artificial nitrates. 100% beef. Check label for current formula. Whole Foods, Target.

entries.name: EPIC Beef Jerky (original sea salt)
entries.details: No soy, no artificial dyes. Check for no added sugar on current label. Whole Foods, REI, Target.

entries.name: Chomps Beef Sticks
entries.details: Grass-fed beef, no soy, no artificial dyes, no HFCS. 10g protein per stick. Whole Foods, Costco, Target.

entries.name: SPAM / Canned Ham
entries.details: Pork [Lev 11:7-8] + soy derivatives. Double violation. No exceptions.

entries.name: Generic deli turkey with 'soy protein'
entries.details: Soy protein isolate listed on most grocery store sliced turkey. Check every label.

entries.name: Great Value Canned Chicken Breast (Walmart)
entries.details: Chicken breast, water, salt. Cheapest clean canned chicken anywhere. Walmart is removing synthetic dyes and 30+ additives from ALL Great Value products by Jan 2027, so this line keeps getting cleaner. Walmart.

entries.name: Good & Gather Canned Chicken (Target)
entries.details: Target's clean private line. Chicken, water, salt. No soy, no broth. Good & Gather is Target's 'no artificial flavors/dyes/sweeteners' brand — a reliable default across the store.

entries.name: Publix Canned Chicken Breast
entries.details: Chicken, water, salt. Clean store label, and Publix is the most convenient stop in Huntsville. Verify no 'vegetable broth' on the current can.

entries.name: Simple Truth Canned Chicken (Kroger)
entries.details: Kroger's Simple Truth line is 'Free From 101+' artificial ingredients — no artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, or preservatives by brand standard. Reliable clean default in any Kroger.

entries.name: GreenWise Chicken / Beef (Publix)
entries.details: Publix's clean line: raised without antibiotics or added hormones, made without the preservatives, flavors, and colors on Publix's published exclusion list. Any GreenWise item is a safe starting point — still read for soy and sugar.

entries.name: Simply Nature Grass-Fed Beef (Aldi)
entries.details: Aldi's clean line — no added hormones, no artificial ingredients. Aldi grass-fed ground beef is one of the best price-per-pound clean beef options in Huntsville. Aldi.

entries.name: Great Value Tuna in Water (Walmart)
entries.details: Tuna, water, salt. Fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Cheapest clean tuna. Avoid the pouches listing 'vegetable broth' — buy the plain water-packed cans.

entries.name: Good & Gather / 365 Sardines
entries.details: Both Target's and Whole Foods' store sardines are packed in water or olive oil with clean labels. Fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Cheaper than Wild Planet, nearly as clean.

entries.name: Store-brand deli turkey with 'soy protein'
entries.details: Most grocery store sliced turkey — including many store brands — lists soy protein isolate and dextrose. Applegate or GreenWise are the safe deli picks.

entries.name: Wild Planet Wild Sockeye Salmon
entries.details: Wild-caught, no soy, no broth, fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Highest omega-3. At Whole Foods, Costco, Amazon.

entries.name: Safe Catch Wild Salmon
entries.details: Mercury-tested, clean label. At Whole Foods, Sprouts. Good for frequent use.

entries.name: Costco Wild-Caught Salmon (fresh/frozen)
entries.details: Best price per pound for fresh salmon. Buy in bulk and freeze portions. Kirkland brand is clean.

entries.name: Member's Mark Wild-Caught Sockeye Salmon (Sam's Club)
entries.details: Wild-caught sockeye, fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. IMPORTANT: Sam's carries both wild-caught AND farm-raised — check each package for the 'wild-caught' label. Wild sockeye is leaner with brighter color. Fresh or frozen. Sam's Club.

entries.name: Trader Joe's Wild Salmon (frozen)
entries.details: Affordable, clean label, no additives. Wild-caught Pacific. Good everyday option.

entries.name: Wild Planet Sardines
entries.details: Water or olive oil. Wild-caught, no soy. One of the most affordable omega-3 sources. Publix, Walmart, Target.

entries.name: Crown Prince Sardines
entries.details: BPA-free can, water-packed, clean label. Walmart, Publix, Winn-Dixie.

entries.name: Starkist Tuna (in water)
entries.details: Widely available and affordable. Standard Starkist albacore in water is clean, BUT check label — some pouches list 'vegetable broth' or 'pyrophosphate.' Choose plain water-pack only.

entries.name: Catfish
entries.details: No true scales [Lev 11:10]. Forbidden. Common in Southern cooking but off this diet. Substitute with tilapia or cod.

entries.name: Shrimp (all forms)
entries.details: No fins and scales [Lev 11:10-12]. Forbidden. Includes fried shrimp, shrimp cocktail, shrimp pasta.

entries.name: Crab, Lobster, Oysters, Clams, Mussels
entries.details: No fins and scales [Lev 11:10-12]. Forbidden in all forms including crab cakes and clam chowder.

entries.name: Member's Mark Shrimp / Crab / Lobster / Catfish (Sam's Club)
entries.details: Sam's stocks all of these prominently in the seafood case [Lev 11:10-12]. Walk past them — no fins and scales means forbidden regardless of the warehouse deal.

entries.name: Great Value Wild-Caught Salmon (Walmart)
entries.details: Frozen wild-caught fillets. Fins and scales [Lev 11:9]. Check the bag says WILD-CAUGHT, not farm-raised or 'Atlantic.' Best budget salmon in Huntsville.

entries.name: Good & Gather Wild Caught Salmon (Target)
entries.details: Frozen wild salmon portions, clean label, no additives. Convenient single-portion packs — easy to cook one at a time.

entries.name: GreenWise Sustainably Sourced Seafood (Publix)
entries.details: Publix's GreenWise wild-caught seafood carries a Sustainably Sourced logo. Choose only fins-and-scales species [Lev 11:9] — salmon, cod, snapper, trout. Skip the shrimp and crab in the same case.

entries.name: Simply Nature / Fremont Fish Market (Aldi)
entries.details: Aldi's frozen wild salmon and cod are clean-label and among the cheapest anywhere. Verify wild-caught on the package.

entries.name: 365 Wild Alaskan Salmon (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Whole Foods store brand, canned or frozen. Clean label, no broth, no soy.

entries.name: Store-brand catfish / shrimp / crab (any store)
entries.details: Every store in Huntsville sells these cheap and prominently — catfish especially in the South. No fins and scales [Lev 11:10-12]. Off the diet regardless of price.

entries.name: Vital Farms Pasture-Raised Eggs
entries.details: Best egg brand for choline, omega-3, and B12. Bright orange yolk = higher nutrient density. Whole Foods, Target, Publix, Walmart.

entries.name: Costco Kirkland Organic Eggs
entries.details: Best price for organic. Not pasture-raised but still clean — no additives. Buy the 2-pack.

entries.name: Member's Mark Organic Brown Eggs (Sam's Club)
entries.details: USDA organic, no additives. Bulk carton at warehouse price. Not pasture-raised (cage-free) but clean for this diet. Sam's Club.

entries.name: Trader Joe's Organic Eggs
entries.details: Affordable clean option. No additives. Good everyday egg.

entries.name: Fage 0% or 2% Plain Greek Yogurt
entries.details: Clean label: milk and live cultures only. High protein. No sugar. Probiotic strains present. Widely available everywhere.

entries.name: Chobani Plain Greek Yogurt
entries.details: Clean label. No added sugar, no artificial dyes. Good probiotic cultures. Walmart, Publix, Target, Costco.

entries.name: Siggi's Plain Icelandic Yogurt
entries.details: Skyr-style, higher protein than standard Greek yogurt. Very low sugar. Clean label. Whole Foods, Target, Publix.

entries.name: Good Cultures Cottage Cheese
entries.details: Live probiotic cultures in cottage cheese. Clean label, no added sugar. Whole Foods, Publix, Target.

entries.name: Lifeway Kefir (plain)
entries.details: 12 live and active cultures. No added sugar in plain variety. High probiotic count. Publix, Whole Foods, Walmart.

entries.name: Kerrygold Butter (salted or unsalted)
entries.details: Grass-fed butter. Clean label: cream and salt. No soy. No artificial additives. Costco carries large packs at best price.

entries.name: 4th & Heart Ghee
entries.details: Grass-fed ghee, lactose-free, no soy, no artificial flavors. Good for high-heat cooking. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.name: Tillamook Cheddar / Sharp Cheddar
entries.details: Clean label: milk, cheese cultures, salt, enzymes. No artificial dyes (orange color from annatto, a natural seed). Costco, Publix, Walmart.

entries.name: Organic Valley Whole Milk
entries.details: USDA organic, no artificial hormones, clean label. If you tolerate dairy. Whole Foods, Publix, Kroger.

entries.name: Member's Mark Organic Whole Milk (Sam's Club)
entries.details: USDA organic, no artificial hormones. Bulk 64oz cartons at warehouse price. If you tolerate dairy. Sam's Club.

entries.name: Flavored yogurt (Yoplait, Dannon, etc.)
entries.details: 20-30g added sugar, often artificial flavors. Off the list regardless of brand.

entries.name: Soy milk / soy yogurt
entries.details: Soy — entirely off this diet.

entries.name: Great Value Organic Eggs (Walmart)
entries.details: USDA organic, no additives. Cheapest organic egg in town. Walmart.

entries.name: Good & Gather Organic / Cage-Free Eggs (Target)
entries.details: Clean label organic eggs. Target.

entries.name: Publix GreenWise Organic Eggs
entries.details: Organic, no antibiotics or added hormones. Convenient if Publix is your regular stop.

entries.name: Simply Nature Organic Eggs (Aldi)
entries.details: Aldi's organic eggs — excellent price, clean label.

entries.name: Great Value Plain Greek Yogurt (Walmart)
entries.details: Milk and live cultures. No added sugar in the PLAIN tub. Cheapest clean Greek yogurt — buy the big plain container and add your own berries.

entries.name: Good & Gather Plain Greek Yogurt (Target)
entries.details: Clean label, live cultures, no added sugar in plain. Solid everyday probiotic base.

entries.name: Publix Plain Greek Yogurt / GreenWise
entries.details: Clean plain yogurt. Check that you grab PLAIN — the flavored tubs beside it carry 15-20g added sugar.

entries.name: Simply Nature Organic Plain Greek Yogurt (Aldi)
entries.details: Organic, clean, cheapest plain Greek yogurt in Huntsville. Aldi.

entries.name: 365 Organic Plain Whole Milk Yogurt (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Full-fat, organic, live cultures, no sugar. Excellent probiotic base.

entries.name: Great Value / Good & Gather Grass-Fed Butter
entries.details: Both stores now carry grass-fed butter store-brand at well under Kerrygold pricing. Ingredients: cream, salt. Clean.

entries.name: Store-brand shredded cheese (any store)
entries.details: Most pre-shredded cheese is dusted with potato starch or cellulose to prevent caking — not a dealbreaker, but block cheese you shred yourself is cleaner and cheaper. Check for added dyes in orange varieties (annatto is natural and fine).

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Elmhurst Unsweetened Walnut Milk
entries.details: 2 ingredients (walnuts, water). No gums, no soy, no sugar. 1,400mg omega-3 per serving. Your top daily choice. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Target, Amazon.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Elmhurst Unsweetened Almond Milk
entries.details: 2 ingredients (almonds, water). Same clean formula as walnut milk. No gums, no soy, no sugar. Same stores.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Elmhurst Unsweetened Oat Milk (Barista)
entries.details: Simple oat-based, no gums in the barista version. Best for frothing in coffee. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Califia Farms Unsweetened Almond Milk
entries.details: 3 ingredients: almonds, water, sea salt. No gums, no soy, no added sugar. Widely available: Walmart, Target, Publix, Costco.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Malk Organics Almond Milk
entries.details: Organic almonds + water + pink himalayan salt only. No gums, no soy. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: So Delicious Unsweetened Coconut Milk (carton)
entries.details: No added sugar, no artificial dyes. Clean carton coconut milk. Whole Foods, Target, Publix.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Native Forest Simple Coconut Milk (can)
entries.details: BPA-free can. Ingredients: organic coconut and water only. No guar gum. For cooking and smoothies. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Pacific Foods Hemp Milk (unsweetened)
entries.details: Hemp seeds + water + pea protein. No soy, no added sugar. Good omega-3 and omega-6 balance. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Ripple Unsweetened (pea protein milk)
entries.details: High plant protein (8g per serving), omega-3 added, no soy, no added sugar. Good post-workout. Walmart, Target, Publix.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Oatly Oat Milk (any variety)
entries.details: Contains rapeseed (canola) oil. Soybean oil in some versions. Not clean for this plan.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Silk Almond / Oat / Cashew
entries.details: Some contain gellan gum, sunflower oil, or 'natural flavors.' Silk Unsweetened Almond is lowest-risk but not ideal — Elmhurst is better.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Almond Breeze
entries.details: Contains carrageenan in some versions. Higher levels of additives than Califia or Elmhurst. Not recommended.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Soy Milk (any brand)
entries.details: Soy — entirely off this diet. Silk Soy, Westsoy, Edensoy: all off the list.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Great Value Unsweetened Almond Milk (Walmart)
entries.details: Cheapest almond milk available. Contains gums (gellan) but NO soy and NO added sugar in the unsweetened carton. Acceptable budget fallback — Elmhurst is still cleaner.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Good & Gather Unsweetened Almond Milk (Target)
entries.details: Clean-ish: no soy, no added sugar, but contains gums. Fine as a backup; not your daily if Elmhurst is available.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Simply Nature Organic Unsweetened Almond Milk (Aldi)
entries.details: Organic, no added sugar, no soy. Contains gums. Best budget organic plant milk in Huntsville.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: 365 Unsweetened Almond Milk (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Whole Foods store brand — shorter ingredient list than most national brands, no soy, no added sugar. Good value clean option.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: 365 Organic Coconut Milk, can (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Organic coconut and water. No guar gum in the simple version. Great for cooking and smoothies.

entries.group: All Plant Milk Brands — Specific Approved Options
entries.name: Great Value Coconut Milk, can (Walmart)
entries.details: Cheap and usually just coconut, water, guar gum. No soy, no sugar. Fine for cooking.

entries.name: Ezekiel 4:9 Sprouted Grain Bread
entries.details: Food For Life brand. Organic sprouted wheat, barley, millet, lentils, spelt. No sugar, no soy lecithin, no preservatives. Nutty flavor, dense. Best toasted. Found in FREEZER section at Whole Foods, Publix, Walmart, Target. Store yours in freezer — no preservatives means it goes stale fast.

entries.name: Ezekiel 4:9 English Muffins
entries.details: Same brand, same clean formula. Great as a burger bun substitute or breakfast base. Freezer section at same stores.

entries.name: Dave's Killer Bread — 21 Whole Grains
entries.details: Organic, non-GMO, no HFCS, no artificial preservatives. IMPORTANT: not all Dave's varieties are soy-free. The 21 Whole Grains & Seeds variety does not list soy lecithin. Check the specific loaf label every time. Publix, Walmart, Target, Costco.

entries.name: Dave's Killer Bread — Powerseed
entries.details: Organic, clean label, no HFCS. Check for soy lecithin on current label. Publix, Walmart, Costco.

entries.name: Alvarado Street Bakery Sprouted Wheat
entries.details: Organic sprouted wheat, naturally leavened, no artificial sweeteners or preservatives. No soy lecithin. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.name: One Mighty Mill Whole Wheat
entries.details: Organic, no cheap seed oils (uses extra virgin olive oil if any oil), no artificial flavors, no soy lecithin. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.name: Canyon Bakehouse Gluten-Free (if needed)
entries.details: Soy-free, dairy-free, nut-free. Made from sorghum, millet, amaranth, teff. Good gluten-free option. Whole Foods, Publix, Target, Walmart.

entries.name: Base Culture Grain-Free Bread (frozen)
entries.details: Paleo-friendly: almond flour, flaxseed, eggs. No grains, no soy, no refined sugar. Dense, best toasted. Whole Foods freezer section.

entries.name: Nature's Own Honey Wheat
entries.details: Contains soy lecithin. Despite 'no artificial preservatives' marketing, soy is present.

entries.name: Wonder Bread / Sara Lee / Pepperidge Farm
entries.details: Soy lecithin and/or HFCS in all standard varieties. Off the list.

entries.name: 365 Organic Sprouted Whole Wheat Bread (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Whole Foods store brand sprouted bread — clean label, no soy lecithin, no HFCS. Cheaper than Ezekiel with a similar profile. Freezer or bread aisle.

entries.name: Simple Truth Organic Bread (Kroger)
entries.details: Kroger's Simple Truth line excludes artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, and preservatives by brand standard. Read the specific loaf for soy lecithin, but the line is a reliable starting point.

entries.name: bettergoods bread (Walmart)
entries.details: Walmart's newer 'made without' premium line, mostly under $5. Cleaner than Great Value by design. Verify no soy lecithin on the specific loaf — the dye/additive cleanup completes Jan 2027.

entries.name: Simply Nature Organic Bread (Aldi)
entries.details: Aldi's clean line — organic, no artificial preservatives. Check the specific loaf for soy lecithin. Excellent price.

entries.name: GreenWise Bread (Publix)
entries.details: Made without the preservatives, flavors, and colors on Publix's exclusion list, with unbleached unbromated flour and expeller-pressed oils. Still read for soy lecithin — the GreenWise standard doesn't automatically exclude it.

entries.name: Store-brand white sandwich bread (any store)
entries.details: Great Value, Publix, Kroger standard white and wheat loaves nearly all contain soy lecithin and/or HFCS. Off the list.

entries.name: Rudi's Organic Rocky Mountain Sourdough
entries.details: Organic wheat flour fermented 24 hours. No soy, no HFCS. Clean label. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.name: Local bakery sourdough (verify label)
entries.details: True sourdough from a local bakery should be: flour, water, salt only. Ask the baker if they use any soy or additives. Huntsville has several local options at the farmers market.

entries.name: Berlin Natural Bakery Spelt Sourdough
entries.details: Organic spelt flour, minimal ingredients, small batch. Non-GMO verified. No soy. Order online or find at Whole Foods.

entries.name: Grocery store 'sourdough-style' bread
entries.details: Most grocery store sourdough is fake — just white bread with vinegar added. No real fermentation, and often contains soy lecithin. Check for 'sourdough starter' or 'cultured wheat' in ingredients.

entries.name: Simple Mills Almond Flour Crackers
entries.details: Almond flour, tapioca flour, cassava flour, herbs. No soy, no refined sugar, no artificial dyes. Multiple flavors — all are clean. Target, Whole Foods, Publix, Walmart, Sprouts.

entries.name: Simple Mills Sea Salt Crackers
entries.details: Cleanest flavor. Same brand. Great with almond butter, hummus, or avocado.

entries.name: Mary's Gone Crackers (Original)
entries.details: Whole grain rice, quinoa, flax, sesame seeds. No soy, no artificial dyes, no refined sugar. Dense and filling. Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.name: RW Garcia Organic Corn Thin (plain)
entries.details: Organic blue corn, sunflower oil, sea salt. Check label for soy-free. Minimal ingredients. Whole Foods.

entries.name: Ritz Crackers
entries.details: Refined enriched flour + soybean oil. Always off this diet.

entries.name: Wheat Thins
entries.details: Soybean oil + refined flour + added sugar. Off the list.

entries.name: Goldfish Crackers
entries.details: Soybean oil + enriched refined flour. Off the list.

entries.name: 365 Organic Woven Wheat Crackers (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Store-brand Triscuit equivalent — whole wheat, oil, salt. Check the oil: choose the version without soybean oil. Simple Mills is still cleaner.

entries.name: Simple Truth Organic Crackers (Kroger)
entries.details: Free-from-101 brand standard means no artificial colors or preservatives. Still verify the oil used — many crackers use sunflower or canola.

entries.name: Good & Gather Almond Flour Crackers (Target)
entries.details: Target's answer to Simple Mills at a lower price. Almond flour base, no soy, no artificial dyes. Verify current label.

entries.name: Store-brand 'butter' crackers (any store)
entries.details: Ritz-style store knockoffs use the same formula: enriched refined flour + soybean oil. Off the list.

entries.name: Siete Cassava Flour Tortillas
entries.details: Cassava flour, coconut oil, cream of tartar, sea salt. No soy, no refined sugar, no dyes. Flexible, burrito-size. Find: Whole Foods, Target, Sprouts, Walmart, Publix. Store in freezer.

entries.name: Siete Almond Flour Tortillas
entries.details: Higher fat, more protein, lower carb. Smaller (taco-size). No soy, no sugar, no dyes. Same stores as cassava version.

entries.name: Siete Chickpea Flour Tortillas
entries.details: 4.5g fat, 4g fiber per tortilla. No soy, no dyes. Good middle ground between cassava and almond flour versions.

entries.name: Mission Corn Tortillas (yellow or white)
entries.details: Ingredients: ground corn, water, trace of lime. 3 ingredients. No soy, no added sugar, no dyes. Best budget-friendly, widely available tortilla option. Walmart, Publix, Target, Winn-Dixie.

entries.name: Trader Joe's Corn Tortillas
entries.details: Clean label corn tortilla. Affordable. Verify current label shows corn, water, lime only.

entries.name: Egglife Egg White Wraps
entries.details: Cage-free egg whites as base. 5g protein, under 1g carb per wrap. Grain-free, no soy, no sugar. Full burrito size. Find: Whole Foods, Publix, Target. Best low-carb, high-protein wrap option.

entries.name: Rise & Puff Cassava-Tapioca Tortillas
entries.details: Cassava + tapioca blend. Puffs up when heated, closest to flour tortilla texture. No soy, no sugar, no dyes. Whole Foods.

entries.name: Homemade Corn Tortillas (masa harina)
entries.details: Bob's Red Mill Masa Harina + water + salt. 3 ingredients. Best texture. Make a batch, refrigerate for the week.

entries.name: Mission Flour Tortillas (any variety)
entries.details: Soybean oil is ingredient #3 in all Mission flour tortilla varieties. Always off this list.

entries.name: Old El Paso Flour Tortillas
entries.details: Soybean oil + refined bleached flour. Off the list.

entries.name: La Banderita Flour Tortillas
entries.details: Soybean oil present. Off the list.

entries.name: Great Value Corn Tortillas (Walmart)
entries.details: Corn, water, lime, trace preservative. No soy, no added sugar. Cheapest clean tortilla in Huntsville — this is your everyday taco base.

entries.name: Good & Gather Corn Tortillas (Target)
entries.details: Clean corn tortilla, no soy. Target.

entries.name: Publix Corn Tortillas
entries.details: Clean 3-4 ingredient corn tortilla. Verify no soybean oil on the current bag.

entries.name: 365 Organic Corn Tortillas (Whole Foods)
entries.details: Organic corn, water, lime. Cleanest store-brand corn tortilla available.

entries.name: La Banderita / store-brand CORN tortillas
entries.details: Most corn tortillas from any brand are clean (corn, water, lime). It's the FLOUR tortillas that carry soybean oil — corn is almost always safe. Read anyway.

entries.details: YES — this one works. 2g sugar, 20 calories per 16oz. NO artificial sweeteners, NO artificial dyes — color comes from vegetable and fruit juice concentrates, not Red 40. Sweetened with stevia plus a bulk sweetener (older formula used erythritol; the 2026 reformulation moved to ALLULOSE, which is the upgrade you want — check your bottle). High potassium. Limit to 1 bottle a day and prefer the allulose-sweetened bottles when you see them. Walmart, Target, Publix, Sam's Club, Costco.

entries.group: Clean Soda Alternatives — For When You Want Something Fun
entries.name: wildwonder Sparkling Prebiotic + Probiotic
entries.details: YES — and it fits your gut-brain strategy better than almost anything else in this section. THE ONLY drink that combines BOTH 5g prebiotic fiber (Jerusalem artichoke + chicory root inulin) AND 1 billion CFU live probiotics (Bacillus subtilis DE111, a spore-forming strain clinically shown to survive stomach acid and reach the gut). USDA Organic, non-GMO, and the allergen panel explicitly confirms FREE FROM SOYBEAN AND ITS DERIVATIVES. No artificial dyes, no artificial sweeteners, no sucralose, no erythritol. Only 6g sugar and 40 calories per can. Primarily sweetened with monk fruit extract (your Tier 1 sweetener). Caffeine-free. Flavors: Guava Rose, Mango Turmeric, Strawberry Passion, Peach Ginger, Pineapple Paradise, Raspberry Lychee. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Kroger, Target, Amazon.

entries.group: Clean Soda Alternatives — For When You Want Something Fun
entries.name: wildwonder — THE ONE CAVEAT (agave)
entries.details: READ THIS BEFORE YOU BUY A CASE. Every wildwonder flavor lists ORGANIC AGAVE NECTAR as a sweetener alongside monk fruit. Agave sits in Tier 4 (AVOID) in your Sweeteners section because it is 70-90% fructose — higher than HFCS — and fructose is metabolized almost entirely by the liver. THE CONTEXT THAT MATTERS: the total sugar is only 6g per can, so the actual agave dose is small (roughly 4-5g). That is a very different thing from a 20g agave-sweetened product. VERDICT: 1 can per day is a clear net win — the 5g prebiotic fiber and live probiotics do more good for your gut-brain axis than 4-5g of agave does harm. Do not drink 3 a day, and do not treat it as a water replacement. If you want zero agave, GT's Synergy Original kombucha is your alternative.

entries.name: wildwonder vs. Olipop vs. GT's Kombucha — which when
entries.details: ALL THREE ARE ON YOUR PLAN; use them for different jobs. wildwonder = the only one with BOTH prebiotic fiber AND live probiotics in the same can, so it is your best single gut-health drink; also the best-tasting soda replacement and a strong mocktail base. OLIPOP = highest prebiotic fiber (9g) but NO live probiotics — best when you want fiber and a classic cola or root beer flavor. GT'S SYNERGY = highest live-culture count and the only one with zero agave, but it is fermented and tart. ROTATION IDEA: GT's in the morning with food, wildwonder in the afternoon as your soda replacement.

FLIP THE BAG OVER. You want the ingredient list to say monk fruit extract (or monk fruit + allulose), NOT erythritol. BRANDS: NOW Foods Pure Monk Fruit, Lakanto Monkfruit with Allulose (not the erythritol version). Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.details: 200-300x sweeter than sugar. Zero calories, non-glycemic — steviol glycosides do not raise blood sugar. Some people taste a slight licorice aftertaste; Reb M has less aftertaste than Reb A. Same warning as monk fruit: many stevia packets are bulked with erythritol or dextrose (which IS sugar). BRANDS: SweetLeaf Stevia (liquid drops — purest form, no bulking agent), Pyure Organic Stevia, NuNaturals Pure Stevia. Liquid drops are cleanest — no filler needed. Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.group: TIER 1 — Best: Zero Glycemic Impact, Gut-Safe
entries.name: Allulose + Monk Fruit blend
entries.details: The gold-standard combination — allulose provides the bulk and mouthfeel, monk fruit provides the intensity. Replaces sugar 1:1 in baking with no erythritol needed. Best of both worlds. BRANDS: RxSugar, Lakanto Monkfruit Sweetener with Allulose, Zeroh. Whole Foods, Amazon, Thrive Market.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Raw / Unfiltered Honey
entries.details: The most biblically celebrated sweetener — named throughout Scripture. Raw honey retains enzymes, antioxidants, trace minerals, and antimicrobial compounds that processed honey loses. STILL SUGAR: about 17g per tablespoon, and it will raise blood glucose. Use 1 tsp at a time, ideally with protein or fat. Local raw honey is best (potential allergy benefit). BRANDS: Nature Nate's Raw & Unfiltered (Walmart, Target, Publix, Sam's Club), Member's Mark Organic Honey (Sam's Club, large bulk jar), Kirkland Raw Honey (Costco), local Huntsville-area farmers market honey. AVOID: 'honey' that lists corn syrup on the label.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Medjool Dates (whole)
entries.details: BEST WHOLE-FOOD SWEETENER. Whole dates bring fiber (7g per 100g) that slows glucose absorption, plus potassium, magnesium, and iron. The fiber is exactly why dates behave better than any syrup. This is why RXBAR works on this plan — dates are the sweetener. Blend 2-3 dates into smoothies, oatmeal, or homemade energy balls. BRANDS: Natural Delights Medjool Dates (Walmart, Publix, Sam's Club), Member's Mark Medjool Dates (Sam's Club bulk container — best value), Costco Kirkland Medjool Dates.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Date Syrup / Date Paste
entries.details: Made from whole dates but the fiber is reduced or removed, so it spikes faster than eating the whole date. Still far better than refined sugar — retains minerals and antioxidants. Use as a 1:1 replacement for honey or maple in recipes. BRANDS: Just Date Syrup (single ingredient: dates), D'vash Organic Date Nectar. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Pure Maple Syrup (Grade A Dark)
entries.details: Real maple syrup only — not 'pancake syrup' (which is HFCS with caramel coloring). Contains manganese, zinc, and over 60 antioxidants. Darker grades have more minerals and stronger flavor, so you use less. STILL SUGAR: about 12g per tablespoon. Limit to 1 tsp. BRANDS: Kirkland Organic Maple Syrup (Costco), Member's Mark Organic Maple Syrup (Sam's Club), Butternut Mountain Farm, 365 Organic (Whole Foods). AVOID: Aunt Jemima, Mrs. Butterworth, Log Cabin — these are HFCS + caramel color, not maple.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Blackstrap Molasses
entries.details: Best mineral content of any sweetener — significant IRON (about 20% DV per tablespoon), calcium, magnesium, and potassium. Given your iron and magnesium priorities, this is a functional sweetener. Strong, bitter-sweet flavor. Use 1 tsp in oatmeal, coffee, or marinades. BRANDS: Golden Barrel Blackstrap Molasses, Wholesome Organic Molasses, Plantation Blackstrap. Walmart, Publix, Whole Foods, Amazon.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Yacon Syrup
entries.details: Unique: it is a PREBIOTIC. High in fructooligosaccharides (FOS) that feed the beneficial gut bacteria you are cultivating with probiotics. Very low glycemic. Molasses-like taste. Works with your gut-brain axis strategy rather than against it. Do not cook with it (heat destroys the FOS) — use raw as a drizzle or in cold applications. BRANDS: Alovitox Yacon Syrup, Sunfood Yacon Syrup. Whole Foods, Sprouts, Amazon. More expensive than other options.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Coconut Sugar
entries.details: Lower glycemic than white sugar and contains trace inulin, iron, and zinc — but it IS sugar. This is what Hu Kitchen chocolate uses, which is why Hu qualifies while conventional chocolate does not. Fine as an ingredient in a clean product; not something to spoon into your coffee daily. BRANDS: Nutiva Organic Coconut Sugar, Wholesome Organic Coconut Sugar. Walmart, Whole Foods, Sprouts.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Mashed Banana / Applesauce (unsweetened)
entries.details: The most underrated sweeteners. Use in baking and oatmeal to replace sugar entirely while ADDING fiber, potassium, and prebiotic starch. A ripe mashed banana replaces roughly 1/2 cup of sugar in most baked goods. Zero label reading required.

entries.group: TIER 2 — Whole-Food Sweeteners: Real Sugar, But Unrefined + Nutrients
entries.name: Cinnamon (not a sweetener, but works like one)
entries.details: Ceylon cinnamon enhances the perception of sweetness with no sugar at all, AND it improves insulin sensitivity. Add to coffee, oatmeal, and walnut milk smoothies. This is the cheapest trick in this entire section — use it liberally.

entries.group: TIER 3 — Sugar Alcohols: Use With Caution
entries.name: Erythritol
entries.details: Zero glycemic, mostly absorbed in the small intestine and excreted unchanged, so it causes fewer digestive issues than other sugar alcohols. BUT: a 2023 Nature Medicine study linked erythritol to increased cardiovascular event risk and platelet activation, and that signal got partial replication in 2025. This is a real concern, not internet noise. Erythritol is also the hidden bulk ingredient in most 'monk fruit' and 'stevia' packets. My recommendation: choose allulose over erythritol whenever you have the option. If you use it, keep it under 10g per day.

entries.group: TIER 3 — Sugar Alcohols: Use With Caution
entries.name: Xylitol
entries.details: Zero glycemic, good for dental health. BUT: a 2024 European Heart Journal study found xylitol is prothrombotic and associated with cardiovascular risk — similar concern to erythritol. Also causes GI distress in larger amounts. CRITICAL: xylitol is highly TOXIC TO DOGS even in small amounts. If there is a dog in your home, keep xylitol products (including Nature's Hollow jam) locked away or skip them entirely. Allulose has none of these problems.

entries.group: TIER 3 — Sugar Alcohols: Use With Caution
entries.name: Sorbitol
entries.details: Rapidly fermented by gut bacteria — causes bloating, gas, and diarrhea. Actively works against the gut healing you are doing with probiotics. Common in sugar-free gum and candy. Off this plan.

entries.group: TIER 3 — Sugar Alcohols: Use With Caution
entries.name: Maltitol
entries.details: Has a significant glycemic impact despite being marketed as sugar-free (GI of ~35). Also causes major GI distress. Common in 'sugar-free' chocolate and protein bars. Off this plan.

entries.group: TIER 3 — Sugar Alcohols: Use With Caution
entries.name: Glycerin / Glycerol
entries.details: Common in low-carb protein bars as a binder and sweetener. Minimal glycemic impact but can cause GI upset. Neutral — not a reason to avoid an otherwise clean product, but not something to seek out.

entries.name: White Refined Sugar (sucrose)
entries.details: The primary target of this entire diet. Spikes blood glucose hard, crashes hard. The crash is what wrecks your focus, patience, and mood 60-90 minutes later. Zero nutritional value.

entries.name: High-Fructose Corn Syrup (HFCS)
entries.details: In nearly every conventional condiment, bread, jelly, and drink. The single most important ingredient to scan for on labels. Off this plan without exception.

entries.name: Brown Sugar
entries.details: White sugar with molasses added back in. The trace minerals are negligible. Metabolically identical to white sugar. If you want the molasses benefit, use blackstrap molasses directly.

entries.name: Raw Cane Sugar / Turbinado / Sucanat / Demerara
entries.details: Marketed as 'natural' and 'less processed.' Metabolically, your body processes them identically to white sugar. The 'less refined' framing is marketing, not nutrition. Off this plan.

entries.name: Agave Nectar
entries.details: Frequently sold in health food stores as a healthy option — it is not. Agave is 70-90% FRUCTOSE, higher than HFCS. Fructose is metabolized almost entirely by the liver and is linked to fatty liver and insulin resistance. Low glycemic index on paper, but metabolically one of the worst options. Skip it.

entries.name: Corn Syrup / Dextrose / Glucose Syrup / Maltodextrin
entries.details: All refined sugars under different names. Maltodextrin actually has a HIGHER glycemic index than table sugar. Hidden in protein powders, seasonings, and 'sugar-free' products. Scan for all of these.

entries.name: Fruit Juice Concentrate
entries.details: The sneakiest one. Marketed as 'no added sugar — sweetened with fruit juice!' but the fiber has been stripped out, leaving concentrated fructose. Metabolically it is sugar. NOTE: this is different from Polaner All Fruit, which uses whole fruit juice as the sole sweetener rather than as an additive on top of sugar — that one still qualifies as a Tier 2 allowance.

entries.name: Sucralose (Splenda)
entries.details: Disrupts gut microbiome composition. This is why Smucker's Sugar Free jam is off the list despite having zero sugar. Also found in Sparkling Ice, many protein bars, and 'diet' products.

entries.name: Aspartame (Equal, NutraSweet)
entries.details: Classified by the WHO/IARC as possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B) in 2023. Found in Diet Coke, sugar-free gum, and diet products. Off this plan.

entries.name: Saccharin (Sweet'N Low)
entries.details: Pink packet. Disrupts gut bacteria. Off this plan.

entries.name: Acesulfame Potassium (Ace-K)
entries.details: Almost always paired with sucralose or aspartame in diet drinks. Found in Sparkling Ice, Bubly Burst, many 'zero sugar' sports drinks. Scan for it.

entries.name: Neotame / Advantame
entries.details: Newer high-intensity artificial sweeteners. Same category, same answer.

entries.name: Coffee / Tea
entries.details: SweetLeaf liquid stevia drops (2-3 drops) or a dash of Ceylon cinnamon
entries.alt: 1st: Stevia drops (no calories, no bulk, no aftertaste in liquid form) • 2nd: Cinnamon (adds sweetness perception + improves insulin sensitivity) • 3rd: Pure monk fruit • Avoid: flavored syrups, Splenda packets, sugar

entries.name: Baking (1:1 sugar swap)
entries.details: Allulose (RxSugar or Wholesome) — browns and caramelizes like real sugar
entries.alt: 1st: Allulose 1:1 • 2nd: Allulose + monk fruit blend (Lakanto with Allulose) • 3rd: Mashed ripe banana or unsweetened applesauce (adds fiber) • 4th: Date paste • Avoid: erythritol-based blends given the 2023-2025 cardiovascular signal

entries.name: Oatmeal / Yogurt
entries.details: Blended Medjool dates or fresh berries — fiber slows the glucose curve
entries.alt: 1st: 2-3 chopped Medjool dates (Sam's Club bulk container) • 2nd: Fresh or frozen berries • 3rd: 1 tsp blackstrap molasses (adds iron) • 4th: Cinnamon + a splash of walnut milk • Avoid: brown sugar, flavored oatmeal packets

entries.name: Smoothies
entries.details: Whole fruit — banana, dates, berries. The fiber comes with it.
entries.alt: 1st: Half a banana + a handful of berries • 2nd: 2 Medjool dates • 3rd: A few drops of stevia if you need more • Never: fruit juice or agave as the sweetener

entries.name: Marinades / BBQ / Sauces
entries.details: Date syrup or 1 tsp raw honey + coconut aminos
entries.alt: 1st: Date syrup (Just Date brand) • 2nd: 1 tsp raw honey • 3rd: Blackstrap molasses for a BBQ depth • 4th: Buy Primal Kitchen BBQ (already sugar-free) • Avoid: conventional BBQ sauce, teriyaki, honey mustard — all HFCS

entries.name: Sweet craving (in the moment)
entries.details: 2 squares of Hu Kitchen or Lindt 85% dark chocolate
entries.alt: 1st: Dark chocolate 70%+ • 2nd: 2 Medjool dates with almond butter stuffed inside (tastes like caramel, delivers fiber + protein + magnesium) • 3rd: Berries with plain Greek yogurt • 4th: Yum Earth lollipop • Never: conventional candy

entries.name: Sweet drink
entries.details: Zevia (stevia-sweetened, no dyes) or Spindrift (real fruit juice, 0-4g)
entries.alt: 1st: Zevia • 2nd: Olipop (2-5g sugar + 9g prebiotic fiber) • 3rd: Sparkling water + a squeeze of lemon or crushed berries • 4th: GT's Synergy kombucha • Never: soda, sports drinks, sweet tea, juice

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Chipotle
entries.details: YOUR #1 FAST FOOD OPTION. Proteins are cooked on a plancha (flat-top) rather than deep-fried, and the chain is unusually transparent about ingredients. ORDER: burrito BOWL (no tortilla) with double chicken or steak, brown rice, black beans, fajita veggies, mild salsa, guacamole, and lettuce. SKIP: chips (rice bran oil, plus salt and lime), flour tortilla (soybean oil), queso, sour cream, and the vinaigrette. NOTE: Chipotle cooks with sunflower and rice bran oil — not ideal, but the proteins themselves are grilled, not fried. Huntsville: 5900 University Dr NW.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Chick-fil-A
entries.details: STRONG PICK IF YOU ORDER RIGHT. ORDER: Grilled Chicken Sandwich (ask for no bun, or eat it open-faced), Grilled Nuggets, Grilled Chicken Cool Wrap, Market Salad or Cobb Salad with GRILLED chicken, Kale Crunch side, fruit cup. Drink: water or unsweet tea. SKIP: anything fried — the breaded chicken cooks in peanut oil and the waffle fries in canola oil, in separate fryers. Also skip Chick-fil-A Sauce, Polynesian, and the lemonade (all high sugar). CAUTION: the grilled filet marinade may contain soy — ask for the allergen sheet if strict. Huntsville: University Dr, Governors Dr, US-72 E.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Taziki's Mediterranean Cafe
entries.details: EXCELLENT FIT — built around grilled protein and vegetables. ORDER: Grilled Salmon feast with basmati rice and a Greek salad, or the Chicken Feast, or the grilled lamb. Salmon is fins-and-scales clean [Lev 11:9]. SKIP: pita bread, and go light on the tzatziki. Ask for dressing on the side. THREE HUNTSVILLE LOCATIONS: Whitesburg Dr, The Foundry on Governors Dr, and Hays Farm on Memorial Pkwy SW.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Fresko Grille Modern Mediterranean
entries.details: Local Huntsville spot — essentially Chipotle for Mediterranean food, build-your-own bowls. ORDER: chicken shawarma bowl with greens, rice or extra vegetables, hummus, and olive oil. Fresh, grilled protein, high vegetable content, no fryer required. SKIP: pita. 3414 Governors Dr SW.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: CHOP N FRESH
entries.details: Local salad and bowl shop, two Huntsville locations. Big custom salads with grilled chicken. ORDER: build-your-own with greens, grilled chicken, quinoa, chickpeas, avocado, pumpkin seeds, olive oil and vinegar. SKIP: shrimp (on several of their bowls) [Lev 11:10-12], bacon [Lev 11:7-8], and creamy dressings. Locations: 6125 University Dr NW and 931 Bob Wallace Ave SW.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Panera Bread
entries.details: Decent salad options and they publish full ingredients online. ORDER: any salad with grilled chicken, dressing on the side. Broth bowls are workable. SKIP: bread, baguette side (swap for apple), all sandwiches, soups with cream, and every pastry. Most dressings contain soybean oil — request oil and vinegar.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Jason's Deli / Newk's
entries.details: Both have salad bars, which give you full control. ORDER: build your own salad, grilled chicken, olive oil and vinegar. SKIP: the bread, the muffins, the soft-serve, and any pork-containing deli meat [Lev 11:7-8].

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Firehouse Subs / Jersey Mike's / Subway
entries.details: WORKABLE ONLY AS A BOWL OR SALAD. ORDER: any sub 'as a salad' or 'in a tub' with turkey or roast beef, oil and vinegar. SKIP: the bread (soy lecithin and sugar in nearly all sub rolls), all pork products — ham, salami, pepperoni, bacon [Lev 11:7-8] — and mayo-based dressings.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Steak 'n Shake
entries.details: Notable exception in fast food: as of 2025 the chain fries its shoestring fries in 100% beef tallow rather than seed oil. That makes the fries cleaner-fat than any other chain. STILL: refined-flour bun, shakes are pure sugar. ORDER: burger patties with no bun, no shake.

entries.group: BEST FAST FOOD — Ranked for Your Plan
entries.name: Five Guys
entries.details: Cooks in peanut oil rather than soybean oil — better than most. ORDER: bunless burger (they serve it in a lettuce wrap or bowl), all vegetable toppings, no ketchup or BBQ sauce. SKIP: fries, bun, milkshakes, and the bacon [Lev 11:7-8].

entries.name: Connors Steak & Seafood (Bridge St)
entries.details: Steakhouses are naturally the best fit on your plan — grilled clean protein, vegetable sides, butter instead of seed oil. ORDER: any steak, or the grilled salmon, with a wedge or house salad (dressing on side) and a vegetable side. SKIP: shrimp and crab appetizers [Lev 11:10-12], the pork chop [Lev 11:7-8], bread service, and dessert. 345 The Bridge St.

entries.name: Char Restaurant (Bob Wallace Ave)
entries.details: Upscale steak and seafood. ORDER: steak or the grouper (fins and scales, clean). SKIP: the catfish [Lev 11:10] — it is on their menu — plus the shrimp and grits and all shellfish appetizers.

entries.name: Stoney River Steakhouse (Madison)
entries.details: ORDER: filet or steak with a wedge salad and vegetable side. SKIP: crab cakes, lobster bisque, whiskey shrimp [Lev 11:10-12], the poppyseed bread and honey butter, and dessert.

entries.name: The Chop House (Madison)
entries.details: ORDER: ribeye, prime rib, or the Mahi-Mahi (fins and scales, clean). SKIP: crab cakes, voodoo shrimp [Lev 11:10-12], and dessert.

entries.name: Bad Daddy's Burger Bar
entries.details: Fully customizable burgers. ORDER: Angus burger with no bun (lettuce wrap), Swiss, mushrooms, grilled onions, side Caesar without croutons, unsweet tea. SKIP: bun, truffle fries, bacon [Lev 11:7-8], and the aioli and mayo-based sauces (soybean oil).

entries.name: Glaze & Green Bistro (Five Points)
entries.details: Fresh Asian bowls with generous vegetables. ORDER: teriyaki BEEF or CHICKEN rice bowl, ask for sauce on the side. SKIP: shrimp bowls [Lev 11:10-12], spring rolls and egg rolls (fried), and be aware that teriyaki and most Asian sauces are SOY-BASED — ask for the bowl plain with vegetables and add your own seasoning.

entries.name: Salt Smokehouse
entries.details: Michelin-guide barbecue — excellent food, but barbecue is a minefield for you. ORDER: smoked chicken or brisket, plain, sauce on the side. SKIP: ALL pulled pork, Texas Twinkies, pork chop, and bacon-wrapped anything [Lev 11:7-8], plus every sweet BBQ sauce (sugar) and the mac and cheese.

entries.name: Melt Huntsville
entries.details: Grilled cheese concept — mostly bread-based. ORDER: they substitute readily; ask for a burger patty in place of ham, and a side salad instead of fries. SKIP: the Cuban and Hawaiian melts (pork) [Lev 11:7-8], beer-batter fries, and Texas toast.

entries.name: Good Company Cafe (Five Points)
entries.details: Breakfast all day. ORDER: eggs any style, avocado, side of fruit, black coffee. SKIP: biscuits and gravy (pork sausage) [Lev 11:7-8], pancakes, and the cookies.

entries.name: Any local catfish house / fish fry
entries.details: Catfish has no true scales [Lev 11:10] and is deep-fried in seed oil. This is the most common 'healthy-sounding' trap in North Alabama. Order grilled clean fish elsewhere.

entries.name: McDonald's
entries.details: Fries and hash browns cook in a blend of canola, corn, soybean, and hydrogenated soybean oil with added natural beef flavor. Buns carry HFCS and soy lecithin, and the sauces are sugar-based. Nothing here is worth the compromise.

entries.name: Burger King / Wendy's / KFC
entries.details: Soybean oil fryers, refined-flour buns, HFCS sauces, and heavy pork presence (bacon on nearly everything) [Lev 11:7-8].

entries.name: Popeyes / Zaxby's / Bojangles
entries.details: Fried chicken chains — breading plus fryer oil plus sugary sauces plus biscuits. Popeyes fries in a beef tallow and palm blend, which is a cleaner fat, but the breading, the biscuits, and the sugar-heavy sauces still disqualify it.

entries.name: Waffle House / Cracker Barrel
entries.details: Both are built on pork — bacon, sausage, country ham [Lev 11:7-8] — plus refined flour and syrup. If you must go, order eggs and grilled chicken plain and nothing else.

entries.name: Pizza chains (all)
entries.details: Refined flour crust with soy lecithin and sugar, pepperoni and sausage are pork [Lev 11:7-8], and the sauce carries added sugar.

entries.name: Sonic / Dairy Queen / Milkshake spots
entries.details: Sugar-delivery vehicles with artificial dyes throughout. The exact spike-and-crash pattern you are eliminating everywhere else.
